nom: celimax The Real Noni Bubble Foam Face Cleanser

avis.titre: so good, another win for celimax
avis.texte: i've tried many korean cleansers but this is my current favorite!! i'm about to finish my first bottle and i can't wait to pick up a new one !! the foam texture is fun and leaves my skin feeling very clean and ready for the rest of my skincare routine. i have sensitive combo acne prone skin and this works well for me!
